calibration_design.correction_rule: Apply pooled monotone Platt correction only if slope > 0.05 and both W7-W8 Brier and log loss improve; otherwise retain Jeffreys-smoothed historical threshold estimates.
calibration_design.reason: Fitted slope collapsed to zero for both scopes/models. The constant benchmark improved scores by shrinking predictions to the pooled hit rate, but it eliminates player-level discrimination and is not useful as a prop-specific probability.

equation_scope: Marginal pass, catch, target and carry decomposition fitted from aggregate player-game records. Full coverage context, defender responsibility, explosive catch, target-depth, routes/dropback and decision-time pressure inputs are absent.
